_meta._PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY_NOTE: This file is parallel infrastructure for the walkforward-validated betting flow. It is NOT currently consulted by run_full_pipeline.py — production live betting uses scripts/betting/betting_unified.py (UnifiedBettingEngine) which has its own defaults: kelly_fraction=0.05, min_edge_pct=3.0, max_edge_pct=7.0. When wiring this file into production, prefer config/betting_rules.py loader (which reads this file). Until then, edits here do NOT affect live behavior.
_meta._disabled_2026_04_28: EPL 1X2 disabled in markets/1X2/enabled_leagues per docs/2026-04-28_epl_subset_findings.md (live ROI -22.6% on holdout). The disable applies if/when this config is wired to production.
_meta.description: Backtest-validated betting rules for the walk-forward CatBoost 1X2 models. Based on deep_backtest_1x2.py + deep_backtest_1x2_subset.py results on 2022-25 walk-forward data. NOTE: 2026-04-28 fresh-model holdout test showed the audit-validated subsets (mid_odds + mid_prob combined) FAIL on 2025-26 data. See docs/2026-04-28_fresh_model_test.md.
notes: ROI point estimates are still slightly negative (-0.4% to -7% depending on filter), but CLV is statistically significant (z > 8) indicating real edge.
Only bets against Market Max (best-of-N bookmakers) — betting vs Pinnacle close loses -10% ROI reliably.
Only bet the filtered subset (mid-odds, mid-probability). Longshots and pure favorites are unprofitable.
100 live bets per league are required before scaling stakes. Until then: paper trade or 0.25% bankroll per bet max.

global._reject_comment: If Market Max unavailable, fall through to next source but log a warning — betting vs a sharper source lowers expected edge.

paper_trade_gate._comment: Until we have 100 live bets per (league, market) confirming backtest, all real stakes capped by this gate. The betting code should divide computed stake by 10 while in paper-trade mode.

1X2._disabled_epl_2026_04_28: EPL 1X2 disabled via B0 (2026-04-28). Empirical 2025-26 holdout ROI -22.6% with fresh model; no filter recovers (mid-odds -23.8%, matchweek-early -32.8%). See docs/2026-04-28_epl_subset_findings.md. Re-enable when: (a) live EPL ROI recovers >0% on a 100-bet rolling window, (b) BTTS or alt market shows positive backtest after Odds API May 1, OR (c) FBref EPL re-scrape with rich stats produces a 1100+ feature model with better holdout ROI.
1X2._comment: Only 1X2 has validated walk-forward edge above baseline. No other market has CLV > 0 in our tests yet. EPL TEMPORARILY DISABLED — see _disabled_epl_2026_04_28 above.

serie_a._edge_reason: Serie A: 10% edge threshold on Market Max produces 904 bets, 66% CLV-positive, z=10.51. At 7% threshold ROI is -7.39% — the stricter filter helps.

premier_league._edge_reason: EPL: 7% edge threshold produces 1000 bets, 64% CLV-positive, z=8.92, flat_ROI -0.39% (CI upper +12%). This is the closest any config came to positive.

subset_filters._comment: Deep subset analysis showed these filter bands are where the real ROI lives. Betting outside them is -30% to -50% ROI in the backtest.

exclusion_filters._longshot_reason: Odds > 7: SA -49% ROI, EPL -19% ROI. Sharp books price these correctly; no edge.
exclusion_filters._lowprob_reason: Model prob < 0.30: SA -35% ROI. The model is poor at predicting upsets from pre-match features.
exclusion_filters._highprob_reason: Model prob > 0.70 with edge < 10%: results are mixed. Only bet very-high-confidence picks if edge is also very high.

class_overrides._comment: Draw bets are the strongest validated sub-strategy in both leagues.

D._reason: Draw bets showed +7.98% ROI (SA) and +12.03% ROI (EPL) at Market Max edge>=7%. Worth a slightly easier edge threshold.

O/U_2.5._disabled_reason: Walk-forward accuracy 49.8% SA / 54.2% EPL — at or below naive-baseline. All backtest ROI configurations are -8% to -12% vs B365 close, no CLV edge found.
O/U_2.5.reenable_when: After Odds API returns and closing-line odds from softer books (not just B365/Pinnacle) can be tested against. If Market Max O/U 2.5 data becomes available and CLV > 0, reconsider.

O/U_1.5._disabled_reason: Walk-forward accuracy matches the naive 'always-yes' baseline (74% in both leagues). No predictive edge above base rate — zero information content. Do not bet.

O/U_3.5._disabled_reason: Same story as O/U 1.5. Naive baseline is always-no at 75%, model matches it. No edge.

BTTS._disabled_reason: Walk-forward accuracy 51.4% SA (base rate 51.4%), 50.4% EPL (base rate 56.8% — model is WORSE than naive). No predictive edge. Revisit after Odds API backfills BTTS closing odds and model is re-evaluated.

Corners._disabled_reason: Walk-forward corners_over_9_5 accuracy 47.9% vs base rate 46.9% (+1pp). corners_over_10_5 accuracy 55.5% vs naive baseline 64.6% (-9pp). Model has zero or negative edge on corner lines. Do not bet.

Cards._disabled_reason: Walk-forward cards_over_4_5 has +3.8pp edge over naive (weak signal). cards_over_3_5 and cards_over_5_5 have zero edge. Not enough signal for live betting. Consider re-enabling cards_over_4_5 after Odds API backfills card closing odds.

AH._disabled_reason: Walk-forward models not trained for Asian Handicap markets. Closing odds available but no model trained. If ever re-enabled, would need its own walk-forward training + backtest first.

DC._disabled_reason: Double Chance derived from 1X2 model. Not separately backtested. Logically should have similar edge to 1X2 Draw bets but against shorter odds — possibly a more stable strategy. Needs direct backtest before enabling.

DNB._disabled_reason: Draw No Bet derived from 1X2 model. Not separately backtested. Prior Feb 2026 live-bet result: 0/2 (100% loss, n=2). Needs own validation.

Player_Props._disabled_reason: No walk-forward model trained. Requires simulator + walk-forward xG regressors. Revisit after simulator foundation is rebuilt.

monitoring._comment: Metrics to track live to validate backtest extrapolation.

shutdown_triggers._comment: Automatic strategy shutdown if live performance deviates badly from backtest.

scale_up_triggers._comment: When to scale stakes from 0.25x bankroll cap to full.
